newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 12.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the May 13 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russia and Chechnya signed a peace accord.
- Russia's government has approved a federal programme worth 50 trillion roubles to boost the production of iron and non-ferrous ores.
- Svyazinvest, a holding company for about 89 regional telephone companies, will auction 49 percent of its shares in two stages under a decree signed by President Boris Yeltsin.
- Eight out of 10 communication satellites providing television broadcasting in Russia need urgent replacement.
- Moscow police have been looking for 10 days for a five- year-old girl who went missing in the capital's Gorky Park during May Day festivities.
